overview:
**Moderate fire danger holds today, with afternoon winds and low humidity as the main drivers.**
- Danger is expected to ease to Low by Saturday (Oct 31) as a cooler, wetter pattern moves in.
- Light rain (around 0.15–0.18") is forecast Sunday into Monday, which should help fuels recover further.
- No Watchout Concerns are currently flagged — 0 of 7 local thresholds are met today.
- No Red Flag Warning or other NWS alerts are active for the area; today is sunny with highs near 55°F.
Stage 1 fire restrictions on BLM Uncompahgre Field Office lands, covering Montrose, Delta, Ouray, San Miguel and nearby counties, were lifted September 18, 2026, and no new restrictions have been reissued since. No active wildfires are burning in or near Gunnison, Montrose, Delta, Ouray, San Miguel, or neighboring counties, and the national sit report shows no new large incidents in the Rocky Mountain Area today.
